description: Five ecoinvent organotin rows to sea water carried the numbers of neutral tin hydrides and compounds from 3.8 to 3.12; ecoinvent 3.13, released 2026-11-04, re-registers them as the dissolved cations, with a number for dibutyltin and triphenyltin and none for diphenyltin, phenyltin and trioctyltin. The earlier releases are corrected to the same, so the merged releases reach one substance per row.

expectations.title: The ecoinvent `Dibutyltin` row reaches one substance under the cation's number, 14488-53-0, from every merged release
expectations.comment: One `water / ocean` row in 3.8 and 3.12. On 5f06833 it was published under 1002-53-5, dibutylstannane, the neutral dihydride; ecoinvent 3.13 registers the dissolved cation and the earlier releases are corrected to it.

expectations.title: The ecoinvent `Triphenyltin` row reaches one substance under the cation's number, 668-34-8, from every merged release
expectations.comment: 3.8 ships 668-34-8; 3.12 shipped 892-20-6 (triphenylstannane) and is corrected. On 5f06833 the substance was published under 892-20-6.

expectations.title: The ecoinvent `Diphenyltin` rows of 3.8 and 3.12 reach one substance
expectations.comment: ecoinvent 3.13 ships the row with no registry number and the formula `C12H10Sn+2`; 1011-95-6 is removed from the earlier releases so the copies are placed by name alike. Met on 5f06833 as well: with the number on both copies they were one substance by number, and without it they have to stay one by name, which is what this pins.

expectations.title: The ecoinvent `Phenyltin` rows of 3.8 and 3.12 reach one substance
expectations.comment: As for Diphenyltin: 2406-68-0 is removed from the earlier releases, following 3.13. Selected by uuid: 3.8 names the same row `Monophenyltin`. Met on 5f06833 as well: with the number on both copies they were one substance by number, and without it they have to stay one by name, which is what this pins.

expectations.title: The ecoinvent `Trioctyltin` rows of 3.8 and 3.12 reach one substance
expectations.comment: As for Diphenyltin: 869-59-0, trioctyltin hydride, is removed from the earlier releases, following 3.13. Met on 5f06833 as well: with the number on both copies they were one substance by number, and without it they have to stay one by name, which is what this pins.
